integrity: Explicit-Euler quotient map and exact proof; symbolic checker is supplementary and not independent certification. No invented external validation.
scientific_limitations: Excludes edge weight w=1/2; Morse–Smale only at h<1/Lambda; almost-global claim h<2/Lambda; unrelated to heterogeneous frequencies or larger graphs. Equilibrium census and general saddle avoidance are prior art. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Full Morse–Smale window for an arbitrarily weighted attractive oscillator triangle
